@copilot Update this PR directly with two small corrections to the new cross-version test code, preserving the current baseline/newer-suite coverage and supported versions.

In both newly added AwsLambdaTestUtils classes under aws-lambda-core-1.0/library/src/test and aws-lambda-events-3.11/library/src/test, remove expectedCloudResourceId() and expectedCloudAccountId(). They hide short expected values behind helpers, contrary to the repository's java-tests instructions. Keep a small helper for detecting ARN API availability if needed, but put the conditional expected ARN/account values directly in each equalTo(...) assertion. Preserve exact assertions of absent attributes on core 1.0.0 and present attributes on the newer runtime; do not replace them with non-exact assertions.

The comments saying getInvokedFunctionArn was added in core 1.2.1 are inaccurate. The published core 1.1.0 and 1.2.0 source JARs both already contain that method. Remove the release-introduction claim or describe only the relevant verified contract, that core 1.0.0 lacks the accessor.

Keep the existing one-PR scope and draft state. Re-run the narrow affected formatting and baseline/newer-core tests after these corrections, preserving the exception-log execution coverage and pinned-latest behavior. Report exact commands/results and the resolved baseline versions/nonzero test counts in your task evidence. Do not change production code or dependency minimums, add unrelated refactors, create a follow-up PR, request reviews, or edit the PR title or description.

Replace that representative collection entry with aws-lambda:aws-lambda-events-3.11:library:version12Test. Keep baseline tests and all version suites wired into check. Keep this one PR in draft state. Do not create a follow-up PR, dispatch additional tasks, request reviews, reply to the review, resolve threads, or edit the PR title or description.

@copilot Update this PR directly rather than opening another PR. Replace the nested `configurations.configureEach { when (name) { ... } }` dependency-inheritance callbacks in all three changed AWS Lambda library builds with the repository's existing targeted configuration pattern. The files are `instrumentation/aws-lambda/aws-lambda-core-1.0/library/build.gradle.kts`, `instrumentation/aws-lambda/aws-lambda-events-3.11/library/build.gradle.kts`, and `instrumentation/aws-lambda/aws-lambda-events-common-2.2/library/build.gradle.kts`.

Use an explicit top-level `configurations { named("...Implementation") { extendsFrom(configurations["testImplementation"]) }; named("...RuntimeOnly") { extendsFrom(configurations["testRuntimeOnly"]) } }` block outside the default test suite and after the appropriate suite registration, accounting for Gradle's registration/realization ordering. Existing examples are `instrumentation/spring/spring-jms/spring-jms-2.0/javaagent/build.gradle.kts` and `instrumentation/runtime-telemetry/library/build.gradle.kts`. Keep the current suite names: `version12Test` in core, `core12Test` in events-3.11, and `version310Test` in common-events. Preserve the just-completed events-suite rename and its `core12Test` metadata-collection reference.

Keep the change limited to clearer, conventional dependency wiring. Preserve the actual inherited dependencies and isolated baseline/newer-version graphs, test sources, JVM settings, exception-log executions, suite-owned `executions` blocks, inclusion in `check`, telemetry collection, support minimums, production behavior, and the PR's draft/base state. Do not introduce shared Gradle infrastructure or another abstraction.

Apply the narrowest appropriate formatting and validate configuration/task registration as well as the affected default and custom suites, including core exception-log executions and the repository's pinned-latest mode. Confirm nonzero test execution and resolved baseline/newer target versions so this cleanup cannot silently drop dependency inheritance or baseline coverage.

replies.body: Replaced the three nested callbacks with top-level named configuration blocks after suite registration in `d1f53714`. Default and custom suites—including core exception-log variants—passed in standard and pinned-latest modes; resolved graphs confirmed the baseline and newer target versions.

threads.body: In 2.2.1, the fluent method is misspelled `withQueryStringParamters`, so `withQueryStringParameters` won't compile. `setQueryStringParameters` exists in both versions and sets the same field. This change preserves the test's behavior while allowing it to run against the declared minimum dependency.
